course_name_original: Introdução à Engenharia de Telecomunicações e Informática
course_name_en: Introduction to Telecommunications and Informatics Engineering
syllabus_topics: What is Telecommunications and Informatics Engineering?
Main areas of Telecommunications and Informatics Engineering

assessment_methods.method: Written synthesis work, individual, on a course-related topic
Oral presentation of the written work
Questionnaires completed at the end of each class

assessment_rules: For students in their first enrollment (normal and resit periods): Written work (50%), Oral presentation of the written work (40%), Class questionnaires (10%). For students in subsequent enrollments (normal and resit periods) and special period (if students choose not to repeat class questionnaires): Written work (55%), Oral presentation of the written work (45%).
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LERC Eng. de Telecomunicações e Informática (IST)
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia de Telecomunicações e Informática (LERC)
